sections.html:
Short stature = Height < 3rd percentile (adult Male < 160 cm, adult Female < 148 cm)

  • ประเมิน น้ำหนัก, U:L segment ratio, arm span และ Target height = MPH ± 7
  • ประเมิน Pubertal staging
การคิด MPH: Mid Parental Height
  • Boy height = (Father Ht (cm) + Mother Ht (cm) + 13) / 2
  • Girl height = (Father Ht (cm) + Mother Ht (cm) − 13) / 2

sections.h: แบ่งกลุ่มสาเหตุ
sections.html:
• Normal variant: CDGP, FSS
  • Idiopathic
  • Pathological — ประเมิน U:L segment ใน adult เป็น 1:1 แล้วแบ่งเป็น Disproportion / Proportion

Normal variant:

  • Normal Puberty Onset (BA=CA): Familial Short Stature
  • Delayed Puberty Onset (BA<CA): Constitutional Short Stature (Late Bloomer)

sub.html:
• Short limb: Skeletal dysplasia, Ricket
  • Short trunk: Scoliosis, Morquio dz

Disproportionate

  • Skeletal Dysplasias (e.g. Achondroplasia)
  • Rickets

• Prenatal
    • SGA
    • Chromosome/syndrome: Turner, Noonan, Down, Prader-Willi, Silver Russel
  • Postnatal
    • Malnutrition
    • Chronic dz: thalassemia
    • Psychologic
    • Endocrine: GH def, Hypothyroid, Cushing, Pseudo hypoPTH

Proportionate — Dysmorphic Features: Trisomy 21, Noonan Syndrome, Prader-Willi Syndrome, Russell-Silver Syndrome, Turner Syndrome

Proportionate — No Dysmorphic Features:

  • Deprivation: Primary Malnutrition, Psychosocial, Deprivation
  • Endocrine: Cushing’s Disease, GH Deficiency, IGF-1 Deficiency (e.g. Laron Dwarfism), Hypothyroidism, Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia, Panhypopituitarism
  • Treatment: Glucocorticoids, Radiation, Chemotherapy, Bone Marrow Transplant
  • Chronic Disease: GI (e.g. Celiac, IBD), Renal (e.g. CRF), Infection (e.g. Chronic UTI), Cardiopulmonary (e.g. Cystic Fibrosis, CHF), Inborn Metabolism Error, Immunologic, Hematologic
  • Other: Intrauterine Growth Retardation, Bulimia Nervosa, Anorexia Nervosa, CNS Tumors (e.g. Craniopharyngioma)
